description:
This process kicks off when a department identifies the need for a new hire.
HR creates a job description and posts it on job boards.
Resumes are collected and screened, followed by initial phone interviews.
Selected candidates are invited for in-person or virtual interviews depending on each candidate's preference.
Once a candidate is chosen, an offer is extended, and salary negotiations may take place.
After the offer is accepted, the onboarding process begins, including paperwork, orientation, and training.
The process concludes once all onboarding steps are completed and the new hire is fully integrated into the team.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Hiring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Hiring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_HiringOrganization" name="Hiring organization" processRef="Process_Hiring"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Candidates" name="Candidates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ResumeSubmission" name="Submit resumes" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneInterview" name="Participate in phone interview" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InterviewInvitation" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteForInterview" targetRef="Participant_Candidates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InPersonInterview" name="Participate in in-person interview" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_VirtualInterview" name="Participate in virtual interview" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Extend offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationToCandidate" name="Salary negotiation" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Participant_Candidates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationFromCandidate" name="Salary negotiation" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfferAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_CreateDescription</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_CreateDescription</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterview" name="Conduct initial phone interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectForInterview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectForInterview" name="Select candidates for further interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectForInterview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectForInterview_Invite</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteForInterview" name="Invite selected candidates for interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectForInterview_Invite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Candidate interview preference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Preference_InPerson</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Preference_Virtual</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Preference_InPerson</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Preference_Virtual</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Interview completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InterviewMerge_SelectCandidate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidate" name="Choose candidate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InterviewMerge_SelectCandidate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectCandidate_ExtendOffer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectCandidate_ExtendOffer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_SkipNegotiation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NegotiationNeeded</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NegotiationNeeded</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Negotiate_Acceptance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Negotiation path complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Negotiate_Acceptance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NegotiationMerge_ReceiveAcceptance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NegotiationMerge_ReceiveAcceptance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Acceptance_Paperwork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Acceptance_Paperwork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Paperwork_Orientation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideOrientation" name="Provide orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Paperwork_Orientation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Orientation_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Orientation_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Integrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreateDescription" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateDescription_PostJob" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostJob_CollectResumes" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectResumes_ScreenResumes" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ScreenResumes_PhoneInterview" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneInterview_SelectForInterview" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterview" targetRef="Task_SelectForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectForInterview_Invite" sourceRef="Task_SelectForInterview" targetRef="Task_InviteForInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_InterviewPreference" sourceRef="Task_InviteForInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_InPerson" name="In-person preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers an in-person interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preference_Virtual" name="Virtual preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers a virtual interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson_InterviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual_InterviewMerge" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InterviewMerge_SelectCandidate" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectCandidate_ExtendOffer" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtendOffer_NegotiationDecision" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationNeeded" name="Negotiation needed" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Salary negotiation is needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipNegotiation" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationDecision" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate_Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NegotiationMerge_ReceiveAcceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Acceptance_Paperwork" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Paperwork_Orientation" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ProvideOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Orientation_Training" sourceRef="Task_ProvideOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="EndEvent_Integrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
